name: ms-company-formation
description: Forming and running a company in Montserrat in 2026 under the Companies Act 2023 (Cap. 11.12, in force 1 April 2024) and the Companies Regulations (SRO 16/2024). Covers the entity types, the registered office and registered agent (a licensed company manager for reporting companies and companies active outside Montserrat), name reservation for 45 days, the incorporation application (EC$400) and certificate (EC$400), the beneficial ownership notice and the member and director particulars within 14 days, foreign company registration, records kept 7 years, the annual return by 1 April (EC$200) and the reporting company audit test (gross revenue of $4 million or gross assets of $2 million). Trigger phrases include Montserrat company formation, register a company in Montserrat, CIPO Montserrat, Montserrat annual return.
